facts.business: Ishita Drugs & Industries Ltd manufactures bulk drugs, fine chemicals and intermediates.

segments.name: Manufacture of Bulk Drugs, Fine Chemicals and Intermediates

capacity_or_capex.item: Renovation of manufacturing facility to meet Revised Schedule M requirements

guidance_or_targets.statement: Once the facility is upgraded as per Revised Schedule M, the Company would be able to get WHO-GMP certification and market products to more countries.

key_risks: Upgradation to Revised Schedule M is a major challenge and threat
Challenges in availability of knowledge resources, skilled manpower and funds
Present business environment is challenging and uncertain due to regulatory changes
Need to raise funds from banks/financial institutions to part-finance the upgradation project
facts.related_party_note: All transactions with related parties are in compliance with section 177 and 188 of Companies Act, 2013 where applicable and details have been disclosed in the Financial Statements as required by applicable accounting standards.
